explanation: The value is 0 at every GO and D2 step, and at every D1 that comes after a trial where the agent chose a1. It rises only at D1 after the agent chose a2 and lost: 10 on the D1 of the trial where it then switches from a2 to a1 (usually after 2-3 unrewarded a2 trials in a row), about 5-8 after one or two a2 losses where it stays with a2, and 0-3 after rewarded a2 trials, and it is strongest in the first half of the episode.
